nodes.label: UNOPEN logo
nodes.description: Horizontal brand logo on a solid black background combining a stylized mark, wordmark, and tagline.

nodes.label: UNOPEN
nodes.description: Brand name shown in the logo as UNOPEN with a registered trademark symbol.

nodes.label: Window-frame logo mark
nodes.description: Left-side stylized mark with a bright orange curve wrapping a dark grey geometric window-pane frame, with a mirrored dark grey layer for depth.

nodes.label: UNOPEN wordmark
nodes.description: Bold all-caps sans-serif wordmark with UNO in bright orange and PEN in dark grey, plus a small dark grey registered trademark symbol.

nodes.label: PVC WINDOW AND DOOR SYSTEMS
nodes.description: Small all-caps dark grey tagline positioned under the PEN portion of the wordmark.

nodes.label: PVC window and door systems
nodes.description: Product domain communicated by the logo tagline: PVC-based window and door systems.

nodes.label: Bright orange accent
nodes.description: Primary accent color used on the logo mark curve and the UNO letters of the wordmark.

nodes.label: Dark grey accent
nodes.description: Secondary accent color used on the window-pane geometry, PEN letters, trademark, and tagline.
